svg.title: TF2 frame tree
svg.desc: A tree of coordinate frames. The root, world, has two children: agv1_frame and top_camera_frame. The arrow from world to agv1_frame is dashed and marked tag 1. agv1_frame has the child agv1_tray_frame, on a solid arrow marked tag 2, and the tray has four children, agv1_slot1_frame to agv1_slot4_frame. top_camera_frame has one child, top_camera_optical_frame, drawn with a dashed outline and marked tag 3. All other arrows are solid.
